title: Chapter 70: Plundering
content:
Chapter 70: Plundering

The alliance army found a place to stay. Wu Qing asked all the Zerg troops to be stationed outside the city. With the host accompanying them, the lords protected the weirdness of the weakened area at night and could only send resources to the Zerg.

Meng, Yu Chong and Bai Yan all knew the specialness of the Zerg and had no objection to Wu Qing's arrangement.

The honest cattle people in the city gave up part of the territory to the alliance army, which was enough for the troops other than the Zerg to camp.

The leader of the cattle people was also a lord. Meng brought wine and meat to eat and drink with him. Not long after, the two began to call each other brothers.

Wu Qing was with Yu Chong and Bai Yan, and did not go with Meng to find the lord of the cattle people.

"This Tengu tribe really doesn't allocate territory and provide supplies to us!"

"Aren't you afraid that we will stab him in the back on the battlefield?!"

Bai Yan rarely took the initiative to bring up the topic.

It was really frustrating to be treated coldly like this. If it weren't for Wu Qing's comfort, with Bai Yan's character, he would have led his troops back long ago.

"They should be on guard against us and won't give us a chance to stab them in the back."

"Are the soldiers under your command also angry? Don't worry, we will take them to vent their anger now!"

"It's still a while before dark. Which race do you think is the most hateful nearby? Let's really go and rob them!"

Wu Qing also understood that normal intelligent creatures are not Zerg, and they will have their own emotions.

Today, everyone came to support without risking their lives, and they were treated so unfairly. The emotions in their hearts can be imagined. If they don't vent, it will greatly affect morale.

Bai Yan heard this, his eyes lit up, thought about it, and said: "Then rob the rat tribe! Although the individual strength of this race is not strong, the population of the race is extremely large, and they act without principles and are very cruel!"

Wu Qing looked at Yu Chong again, and Yu Chong nodded in agreement.

"Okay! Then hurry up and set off now!"

"All combat troops, travel light, let's have a blitzkrieg!"

Wu Qing got up and went to gather the Zerg army.

Sensing the movement of the alliance army, Meng and the lord of the cattle tribe also came over.

Meng stopped Wu Qing and asked, "Wu Qing, what's going on?"

Wu Qing rode a tall horse, followed by ten insect heavy cavalrymen.

"The army is angry and morale is very low. Take them out to rob and boost morale!"

Wu Qing laughed.

"Haha! Good! I like this!"

"Wait for me! I'll be there soon!"

Meng left the lord of the cattle tribe and was about to run.

"I'll go and see too!"

The lord of the cattle tribe, named Niu Kun, turned around and went to gather the troops. He actually wanted to participate in such a thing!

"This cattle tribe is interesting!"

Wu Qing watched Niu Kun stride away and didn't think about it anymore.

He came to the outside of the city and ordered the insect troops to set off immediately and rushed to the territory where the rat army was stationed not far from here.

The follow-up troops rushed out of the city continuously, including a team of cattle infantry, who followed the front troops at full speed.

With the speed of the Zerg troops, they soon reached the territory of the Rat Army. The Zerg troops were not in a hurry to take action. They had no morale and would not be emotional no matter what kind of injustice they suffered.

The Zerg army surrounded the small territory city.

The nervous Rat Army all climbed the city wall. Their leader was shouting loudly and wanted to say something, but Wu Qing didn't want to listen at all and just pretended that he didn't hear anything.

After all the follow-up troops arrived, the big "loudspeaker" shouted to the city.

"Everyone in the city, listen to me! Our army is now hungry! Hurry up and hand over all the supplies in the city to me!"

"Otherwise, wait until we kill into the city! No chickens or dogs will be left!"

In the territory of the Tengu clan, there are many people who raise chickens, but almost no people who raise dogs. Meng's words are also very poisonous.

"It's easy to talk! We don't have much supplies. We all work under the great Tengu tribe. If we have difficulties, we should ask for help from above, not rob our colleagues!"

The Rat leader seemed to have not realized the seriousness of the problem. He was still trying to reason with Meng, relying on the fact that he was in the Tengu tribe's territory and was surrounded by the Alliance army.

"Who the hell is your colleague!"

"If we don't teach you a lesson, do you really think we dare not fight you!"

"Listen! No resistance! Those who resist will die!"

As Meng's words fell, the Zerg Hydralisk fired a volley at the wall in front. The powerful spikes made the wall bumpy, and the originally simple wall became shaky.

A thousand Yu Clan archers, under the command of Yu Chong, each accurately shot off an object on the Rat soldiers on the wall.

Such precise shooting scared the Rat soldiers who escaped the disaster and made them tremble like sieves. Seeing this scene, the Rat leader's face turned pale.

Niu Kun, who came to join in the fun, had his eyes lit up, and couldn't help but applaud the long-range attack capabilities of the Hydralisks and Feather Clan Archers.

Eight one-star Hydralisks fired several high-speed volleys at the tightly closed gate of the small town, and the gate collapsed.

"Go in and grab it! Anyone who dares to resist will be killed without mercy!"

With a loud shout, the Alliance army rushed into the city.

The first to rush in were the puppies. More than 10,000 puppies were enough to easily control all the rat soldiers. The other troops entered the city like they were having fun, and went around the city!

They finally got their heads held high!

Facing the terrifying puppies, the rat soldiers did not dare to move, and stayed where they were. The rat leader, under the threat of Meng, also stood where he was, not daring to leave.

The omnipresent puppies explored every corner of the city. The elite troops from various territories that entered the city later became porters and emptied the city of useful things.

The things that were inconvenient to carry and the edible things were swallowed by the puppies on the spot. The horrible eating appearance of the puppies scared many rat soldiers, who were afraid that the puppies would eat them too.

The infantry of the cattle tribe led by Niu Kun did not enter the city. Although they were not welcome in the sphere of influence of the Tengu tribe, they did not go to such an extent with the Tengu tribe.

They followed just to watch the fun, because although they were honest, they were not stupid, and they were also angry in their hearts.

Seeing the alliance army slap the face of the Tengu tribe like this, they were secretly happy.

It was getting dark and time was running out. The alliance army grabbed things and ran away, not daring to delay.

When the last puppy withdrew from the city, the whole town was already in a mess, and the rat soldiers' dinner tonight became a problem.

There were Tengu cavalrymen monitoring the alliance army around, and the situation here had been reported, but no one with a say came to deal with it.

Wu Qing rode on his warhorse and looked around in the sunset, but he didn't see anyone who should have appeared.

"What is the situation with this Tengu clan? With this level, can it be called a big clan?"

Wu Qing was also confused.

He did not play by the rules and wanted to break the situation, but he didn't expect that the other party would play by the rules even more than him, and it was not like a normal person's thinking at all.

If no one came to call the alliance army to fight tomorrow, Wu Qing would have to find a chance to fight and take the initiative to fight.

After all, he boasted that he would send back the elites of several territories in two days.
